title: Swap Non-Copy Cells
goal: Exchange non-Copy values inside two Cell wrappers without taking or copying.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Cell methods

hints: String does not implement Copy, so get() is not available on Cell<String>.
Cell provides a dedicated method to swap contents between two Cell instances directly.
explanation: `Cell::swap` exchanges inner values directly in memory through shared references, working for any type regardless of whether it implements `Copy`. `b.get()` produces `E0599` because `String` is not `Copy`. Using `a.set(b.take())` or `a.replace(b.take())` moves the string out of `b` into `a`, but leaves `b` containing an empty string instead of completing the exchange.
